thread:
Maria: noticed Cloud KMS audit events for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/sealed-secrets stopped at ~2026-03-20T11:58Z. No ADMIN_READ entries after that. :eyes:

SRE Bot: alert: KMS_AUDIT_MISSING for infra/sealed-secrets at 2765432100 (detected config delta).

Maria: @Dan did you push the org-policy change last night? I saw an org-policy bot PR that looked related.

Dan: I ran a cleanup of stale reviewer bindings at 11:56 UTC but I didn't intend to touch KMS audit settings. Pulling terraform state + plan now.

Kevin: partner webhook CI started throwing vault transit unwrap errors at ~12:03 UTC, many retries. Logging shows decode failures.

Security Oncall: quick triage: auditConfig entries for ADMIN_READ were removed for that key. Common causes: an org policy or terraform module toggled audit to disabled, or a logging role was removed. Recommend: (1) re-enable audit immediately, (2) enumerate decrypts in the window, (3) scan Vault audit for unwraps and any plaintext returns, (4) rotate any long-lived creds used.

Maria: Agreed. I'll coordinate. Dan, can you reapply the auditConfig? Kevin, please run a logging query for decrypt ops between 11:50 and 12:20.

Dan: re-applied auditConfig at 2765432465 and forced a policy refresh. Can confirm logging ingestion resumed. Poking the org-policies module now.

Kevin: query used:
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:('google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt' OR protoPayload.methodName:'google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricDecrypt') AND timestamp>="2026-03-20T11:50:00Z" AND timestamp<="2026-03-20T12:20:00Z"" --project=redwood-prod --format=json
```
Summary: 4 decrypts in window: 3 from ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com, 1 from partner-sync@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com @ 2026-03-20T11:59:12Z.

Security Oncall: cross-ref Vault audit (transit/unwrap) for same timestamps. If partner-sync used a long-lived token to unwrap, treat it as compromised until rotated.

Kevin: matched transit/unwrap at 2026-03-20T11:59:12Z from partner-sync. That service was using a long-lived static token. Initiating rotation and will deploy an ephemeral SA with short TTL and workload identity.

Maria: Good. Dan, any root-cause from terraform side?

Dan: found cause: org-policies terraform module allowed an empty list to implicitly set kms_audit_mode = "disabled" for some entries due to a defaulting bug. I opened PR to change default to "enabled" and added a sentinel unit test + a terraform plan guard that fails CI if any KMS key would remove auditConfig.

Kevin: rotation done: partner-sync token revoked at 2765433600. Deployed ephemeral SA with 1h TTL and updated partner webhook. Added CI acceptance test verifying Vault unwraps require ephemeral SA and that KMS decrypt events appear in logs.

Security Oncall: did a Vault audit sweep for plaintext returns on secret/partner/* and transit/* paths in the 11:50-12:20 window. Found only the partner-sync unwraps. No anomalous reads. Severity downgraded M1 -> M2 after revoke + rotation.

Maria: action items recorded:
- Dan: merge org-policies fix, add plan guard, and monitor terraform applies (owner: Dan)
- Kevin: confirm partner ops applied new token + CI acceptance tests (owner: Kevin)
- Security Oncall: create an alert for any KMS key that loses ADMIN_READ audit entries and add a weekly conformance job that checks auditConfig presence (owner: Security Oncall)
- Maria: prepare incident summary for compliance & notify partner (owner: Maria)

Dan: merged fix and added a policy-level deny in the module so further attempts to set audit to disabled will fail plan. Will watch for drift alerts for 24h.

Kevin: added a small ops snippet to playbook:
```
# quick check
gcloud kms keys describe projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/sealed-secrets --format='json' | jq '.auditConfig'
```
Also added an automated smoke check that runs daily to assert presence of decrypt events for expected service accounts.

Maria: thanks. We'll keep thread open for 24h and close if no anomalies. :thumbsup:
